english.title: Keep animals for slaughter for value of fur or breeding progeny
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[an animal,]_
(B)_[animals,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL OR ANIMALS..) solely or primarily for

english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) and (4) of the Fur Farming (Prohibition) Act 2000.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
keep animals
solely / primarily for
slaughter / breeding progeny for slaughter
for the value of their fur

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: There is also an offence under section 1(2) of allowing others to keep such animals - not yet on PNLD. See section 2 for court's power of forfeiture.
